title: Mount Storm Power Station
geometryBasis: The named generating station on Mount Storm Lake and OSM area 839493843 identify the facility. USDA’s public-domain NAIP map, the two Qualla photographs and the federal stack coordinates fix the exterior layout.
sectionBasis: Long pale turbine hall, stepped boiler houses, attached coal conveyor, tapering tall pair and two shorter retained chimneys from the 2000 photographs. The 743-foot and 579-foot stacks use EPA Table 4-2 heights and flue sizes.
limitations: The exterior is dated to fall 2000. The scope covers the visible generating complex and attached conveyor approach, with the reservoir and open coal yard supplied by the surrounding scene.

The four stack positions use EPA or OpenStreetMap controls and only the two tallest stack heights are verified measurements. Short stack heights, attached machinery, elevations and cladding are approximate.

The USDA orthophoto is from 2007. It fixes the visible 2000-era generating campus in plan, with later exhaust equipment and full lake and stockyard infrastructure outside scope. Foundations are estimated from the original terrain without altering it.
